recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: private genomics labs running behind encrypted computation walls
learning to read paintings one brushstroke at a time
open payment rails humming beneath everyday transactions
san francisco summer haze at twenty degrees
agents waking from a phone before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Drift through a fog bank collecting encrypted DNA helix fragments before they dissolve; each fragment peels back a layer of a hidden painting beneath the mist.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to steer through the fog
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every run reveals another brushstroke of the painting underneath
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens and fragments blink out faster as wind picks up
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor medical illustration over impressionist canvas

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap payment pulses in sync with open bitcoin nodes lighting up across a wireframe city as dawn breaks over the bay.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: chaining perfect taps unlocks a sunrise over the skyline in 45 seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: tempo doubles and nodes split into overlapping polyrhythms

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one-thumb paths between agent nodes on your phone screen before a sunrise deadline erases any unused connection.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: completing a circuit ships a tiny feature and clears the board
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: nodes multiply and paths must not cross as the countdown shrinks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout blueprint with warm dawn gradients

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort brushstroke layers of a half-finished painting by hue and pressure before the gallery closes for the night.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each sorted layer adds detail to a single frame you can screenshot
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: strokes arrive faster with near-identical shades that trick the eye
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: impressionist palette splashes on linen texture
